headline: Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 exploitation attempts begin; GitHub issues abused against 61 repos; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day patched

bullets.text: New: exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Five outlets are now tracking Oracle EBS.

Attackers turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repositories in less than an hour. Separately, GitHub launched an npm firewall meant to block malicious packages before installation.

Cisco patched CVE-2026-76418, an actively exploited ASA and FTD VPN zero-day used to crash SSL VPN devices, its second firewall VPN zero-day since August. Cisco SD-WAN zero-day exploitation has also been tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) rooted 25 servers and breached a U.S. government-affiliated network. CISA's due date is today, 2026-10-29; fixes are in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35.

KEV deadlines: Linux kernel CVE-2026-46300 is due 2026-10-31; Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497 are due 2026-11-10; VMware ESX logging flaw CVE-2026-41709, used as a zero-day by China-linked actors, is due 2026-11-11.

Breaches: hackers stole 2.6 million records from Sony's Japanese ISP So-net; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff, including undercover ICE agents; an HHS filing puts the iRhythm toll at 8.2 million.

actions: Confirm Oracle's patch for E-Business Suite CVE-2026-101767 is applied and check EBS logs for exploitation attempts.
Check your public GitHub repos for unexpected issues, commits or workflow runs, and limit token permissions for workflows triggered by issues.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418 now, review VPN logs and crashes, and check SD-WAN against Cisco's advisories.
Finish PHP updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 today, including firewalls and appliances, and check exposed hosts for compromise.
Apply your distribution's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31, starting with multi-user and internet-facing Linux hosts.
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 despite its low score, and Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 before 2026-11-10.
